headline: Gabriel India Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Gabriel India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding clarification in respect of the valuation undertaken in connection with the proposed acquisition of equity shares of HL Mando Anand India Private Limited and the…
detail: General Updates - Gabriel India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding clarification in respect of the valuation undertaken in connection with the proposed acquisition of equity shares of HL Mando Anand India Private Limited and the related preferential issue of equity shares of the Company.
